tagline: Keep working while GitHub is down
brief: A self-hosted mirror of a GitHub organisation that developers keep working on during an outage, and that replays their work to GitHub safely afterwards.
criteria: Success: not another letter G or cloud, distinct among developer tools, clear at 16 px, works in one colour and on dark backgrounds.

concepts.name: Paper boat
concepts.idea: A folded paper boat that keeps your work afloat until GitHub is back.
rationale: An object, not a letter: nothing like Google's G or GitHub's cat
Folded paper says made by hand, light and friendly; the boat says safe passage
Four flat facets, clean angles; a two-colour cut for 16-48 px

recommendation: Paper boat: friendly and distinct among developer tools, and it reads at favicon size.
next_steps: Replace the old anchor files in docs/logo
Add the favicon and header logo to the web interface
